Absolutely incredible.

The US 10Y Note Yield is now up +70 basis points this month.

We are now above 5.15% for the first time since June 2007.

The bond market is trading like the Fed is hiking rates by 50 basis points at a time.

Q4 is going to be interesting to say the least.
